subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should OpenClaw formally support `supportsReasoningEffort`, `supportedReasoningEfforts`, and `reasoningEffortMap` as validated OpenAI Responses compatibility configuration, with that metadata controlling available and serialized reasoning efforts?
rationale: The patch turns provider-specific reasoning capability into a validated configuration and shared-type contract; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want this durable public configuration direction or a narrower provider-owned alternative.

options.title: Accept the compat contract
options.body: Keep this branch as the canonical implementation after it adds a redacted current-head live request trace and the existing conservative tests remain green.

options.title: Constrain the surface
options.body: Keep xhigh handling limited to an existing provider-owned contract and remove or redesign the new Responses config/schema fields before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer extended compatible-provider reasoning exposure until maintainers define a broader provider capability policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the compat contract
recommendation.body: Keep this branch as the canonical implementation after it adds a redacted current-head live request trace and the existing conservative tests remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent merged xhigh compatibility work makes them the strongest available routing contact for the shared provider-capability policy.
